title: Differentiate a composed model
scope: Derivative of a specified scalar composition

items.prompt: For y=(2x+1)², compute dy/dx at x=1. Treat x as a dimensionless scalar.
items.solution: Chain rule: 2(2x+1)×2. At x=1, this is 12. A finite-difference check should approach this value.
hints: Identify the requested quantity and its units before calculating.
